definition: to eat a small amount of food between meals
sentence: We have a snack after school.

definition: to ask a server to bring you a drink
sentence: I order a drink at the café.

definition: to request the list of food and drinks
sentence: Ask for the menu before you choose.

definition: to hand the salt to another person
sentence: Could you pass the salt?

definition: to take food or drink for yourself
sentence: Please help yourself to some salad.

definition: to eat a meal in a restaurant or café
sentence: We eat out on Friday.

definition: to arrange for a restaurant to keep a table for you
sentence: I book a table for two.

definition: to share the cost of a meal with other people
sentence: We split the bill after lunch.

definition: to leave extra money for the person serving you
sentence: They leave a tip for the waiter.

definition: to tell a business what you want to buy
sentence: She places an order for two sandwiches.

definition: to sit down, often after being invited
sentence: Please come in and have a seat.

definition: to cut something into smaller pieces
sentence: Cut up the apple for the child.

definition: to make food or liquid warmer
sentence: Heat up the soup before lunch.

definition: to become less hot
sentence: Let the soup cool down.

definition: to have eaten enough and not want more food
sentence: I am full after dinner.

definition: to finish all of a drink
sentence: Drink up before we leave.

definition: to pay using notes or coins
sentence: I pay in cash at the market.

definition: to pay using a bank or credit card
sentence: Can I pay by card?

definition: to request money back for a purchase
sentence: She asks for a refund for the broken toy.

definition: to take a purchased product back to the seller
sentence: I return an item that does not fit.

definition: to be available at a lower price than usual
sentence: These shoes are on sale.

definition: to use something to see whether it works or you like it
sentence: Try the headphones out before you buy them.

definition: to keep money for future use
sentence: She saves money in a jar.

definition: to pay money that is owed
sentence: She makes a payment for the electricity bill.

definition: to return money that you borrowed
sentence: I pay back the money on Monday.

definition: to look at different shops before choosing what to buy
sentence: We shop around for a new table.

definition: to exchange one currency for another
sentence: We change money before the trip.

definition: to search for something offered at a good low price
sentence: She looks for a bargain at the market.

definition: to keep part of your money for later
sentence: I put money aside each month.

definition: to keep the document showing what you paid
sentence: Keep the receipt in case you need it.

definition: pay all the money that you owe
sentence: I finally paid off the loan.
